About Me

Teaching that turns complex ideas into simple steps

I am an ICT and Computer Science educator with more than two decades of experience across CBSE, IB (MYP/DP) and British curricula, from KS3 to A-Level.

I focus on clear explanations, differentiated instruction and building confidence. I help students of every level, including multilingual learners, turn abstract ideas into skills they can use.

I am a CBSE National Resource Person and co-author of the CBSE Digital Citizenship manual. I have also built live EdTech applications that schools use every day.

In the Press

Featured in NIE & Akshara’s VisionX launch

Two recent features on my teaching, digital dialogue and student-built AR/VR innovation.

📰 NIE · Teacher Speak

“Navigating the Digital Dialogue”

Published in NIE (Newspaper in Education) on 23 September 2025, reflecting on how our online words shape our reputation.

  • Clarity and intention in online interactions
  • The power of a thoughtful pause before “send”
  • How everyday digital choices shape our reputation
🥽 VisionX · AR & VR

“Visualise, Experience, Learn”

Akshara International School inaugurated VisionX in the Computer Lab, a student-driven initiative that brings Augmented and Virtual Reality into classroom learning, aligned with UN SDG 4 – Quality Education.

  • First time: a team of AR/VR coders trained to build curriculum-based teaching
  • Six immersive platforms built entirely by students: three AR and three VR sites on Food, Animals and Transport
  • Praised by dignitaries for innovation, technical execution and student ownership
